$comment: Rules an outside tool enforces: tool -> where it runs -> tool rule -> rule ids. The generator lists them in enforcement.md (docs/guides/guidelines.md).

swiftlint.runsIn: Lint: `swiftlint --strict` with `.swiftlint.yml`; the PostToolUse hook on each edited Swift file

swift-format.runsIn: Lint: `swift format lint --strict` with `.swift-format`; the PostToolUse hook formats each edited Swift file

swiftc.runsIn: Type-check and Unit tests: `swift build` with the settings in `app/Package.swift`

commitlint.runsIn: the commit-msg hook and CI, with the scope list in `CONTRIBUTING.md`

gitleaks.runsIn: the pre-commit hook and CI, over the tree and every PR commit

oxlint.runsIn: Lint: `npm run lint` in `site/` (`oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings`, `.oxlintrc.json`); staged site files in the pre-commit hook, without type information

knip.runsIn: Lint: `npx knip` in `site/` (`knip.jsonc`); `make verify` when the site changed

typos.runsIn: Repo checks (`verify.mjs`), on staged files in the pre-commit hook, with `_typos.toml`

shellcheck.runsIn: Repo checks (`verify.mjs`) on every `*.sh` and `.githooks/*`; staged ones in the pre-commit hook

actionlint.runsIn: Repo checks (`verify.mjs`); the pre-commit hook when a workflow is staged

zizmor.runsIn: Repo checks (`verify.mjs`, `--offline`); the pre-commit hook when a workflow is staged

agnix.runsIn: Repo checks (`verify.mjs`, `--strict`); the pre-commit hook when an agent file is staged
